contract.purpose: Move a quantity between the ten status buckets of a shipment detail.
inputs_defaults: CREATE PROCEDURE SDB_MoveQtyToSts( @iIntShipLineNum numeric(9), @dMoveQty numeric(19,5), @iFromSts numeric(3), @iToSts numeric(3)) AS
Only explicit declaration defaults permit omission; catalog has_default_value is not used to infer T-SQL defaults.
null_and_invalid_input_behavior: No explicit validation for NULL/negative move amount, zero destination, sorted/unique source statuses or missing detail. Helper return behavior governs absent/NULL inputs.
output_shape: No result set; severity18 resource-based errors and return-1 for absent source status or insufficient source quantity, plus checked UPDATE errors.

ordered_branches.explanation: Reads all10 status/quantity pairs and shipment number with UPDLOCK. Helpers locate source status and quantity; subtracts requested move quantity. Missing source position<=0 or negative remainder errors. Positive remainder updates source bucket; otherwise shifts later pairs left and clears final slot. Locates destination after this removal, adds move amount to existing quantity or finds sorted insertion position and shifts pairs right before inserting. No guard for an eleventh occupied status: inserting while10 remain can overwrite/discard a final pair. Negative move quantity is not rejected and can reverse quantities; NULL arithmetic can bypass guards and follow removal branch. Writes all10 pairs plus process/UTC stamp by line ID, leaving TOTAL_QTY unchanged. After writing, recomputes leading/trailing status and calls STH_UpdateHeader only if either compares different, propagating checked child errors.
